entries.title: Genesis 10:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
A.M. 1676. B.C. 2228. And the. 9:22; 1Ch 1:8-16; 4:40; Ps 78:51; 105:23,27; 106:22 Ham.Ham signifies burnt or black; and this name was peculiarly significant of the regions allotted to his family. To the Cushites, or descendants of Cush, were allotted the hot southern regions of Asia, along the shores of the Persian Gulf, Susiana or Chusistan, etc.; to the sons of Canaan, Palestine and Syria; to the sons of Mizraim, Egypt and Libya, in Africa.

are the. 1,20,31; 5:29-31 and by.Any man who can barely read his Bible, and has but heard of such people as the Assyrians, Elamites, Lydians, Medes, Ionians, and Thracians, will readily acknowledge that Asshur, Elam, Lud, Madai, Javan, and Tiras, grandsons of Noah, were their respective founders.
